SELECT `i`.`invoice_id` AS `Id`, `i`.`so_id` AS `SoId`, `i`.`customer_id` AS `CustomerId`, `i`.`warehouse_id` AS `WarehouseId`, CASE
    WHEN `c`.`customer_id` IS NOT NULL THEN `c`.`name`
    ELSE 'No customer'
END AS `CustomerName`, `c`.`email` AS `CustomerEmail`, CASE
    WHEN `w`.`warehouse_id` IS NOT NULL THEN `w`.`Name`
    ELSE 'All Warehouses'
END AS `WarehouseName`, `i`.`invoice_number` AS `InvoiceNumber`, `i`.`invoice_date` AS `InvoiceDate`, `i`.`due_date` AS `DueDate`, `i`.`status` AS `Status`, `i`.`total_amount` AS `TotalAmount`, `i`.`paid_amount` AS `PaidAmount`, `i`.`balance_amount` AS `BalanceAmount`, COALESCE((
    SELECT `c0`.`payment_method`
    FROM `customer_payments` AS `c0`
    WHERE (`c0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND NOT (`c0`.`is_cancelled`)
    ORDER BY `c0`.`payment_id`
    LIMIT 1), 'N/A') AS `PaymentMethod`, COALESCE((
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
    FROM `sales_returns` AS `s`
    WHERE (`s`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) AS `ReturnedAmount`, CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s0`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
        FROM `sales_returns` AS `s0`
        WHERE (`s0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s0`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN NULL
    WHEN COALESCE((
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s1`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
        FROM `sales_returns` AS `s1`
        WHERE (`s1`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s1`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) >= `i`.`total_amount` THEN 'Fully Returned'
    ELSE 'Partially Returned'
END AS `ReturnStatus`, (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM `invoice_items` AS `i0`
    WHERE `i0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AS `ItemCount`
FROM `invoices` AS `i`
LEFT JOIN `customers` AS `c` ON `i`.`customer_id` = `c`.`customer_id`
LEFT JOIN `warehouses` AS `w` ON `i`.`warehouse_id` = `w`.`warehouse_id`
WHERE NOT (`i`.`is_cancelled`)
ORDER BY `i`.`invoice_id` DESC
LIMIT @__p_1 OFFSET @__p_0

    WHEN `c`.`customer_id` IS NOT NULL THEN `c`.`name`
    ELSE 'No customer'
END AS `CustomerName`, `c`.`email` AS `CustomerEmail`, CASE
    WHEN `w`.`warehouse_id` IS NOT NULL THEN `w`.`Name`
    ELSE 'All Warehouses'
END AS `WarehouseName`, `i`.`invoice_number` AS `InvoiceNumber`, `i`.`invoice_date` AS `InvoiceDate`, `i`.`due_date` AS `DueDate`, `i`.`status` AS `Status`, `i`.`total_amount` AS `TotalAmount`, `i`.`paid_amount` AS `PaidAmount`, `i`.`balance_amount` AS `BalanceAmount`, COALESCE((
    SELECT `c0`.`payment_method`
    FROM `customer_payments` AS `c0`
    WHERE (`c0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND NOT (`c0`.`is_cancelled`)
    ORDER BY `c0`.`payment_id`
    LIMIT 1), 'N/A') AS `PaymentMethod`, COALESCE((
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
    FROM `sales_returns` AS `s`
    WHERE (`s`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) AS `ReturnedAmount`, CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s0`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
        FROM `sales_returns` AS `s0`
        WHERE (`s0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s0`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN NULL
    WHEN COALESCE((
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s1`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
        FROM `sales_returns` AS `s1`
        WHERE (`s1`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s1`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) >= `i`.`total_amount` THEN 'Fully Returned'
    ELSE 'Partially Returned'
END AS `ReturnStatus`, (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM `invoice_items` AS `i0`
    WHERE `i0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AS `ItemCount`
FROM `invoices` AS `i`
LEFT JOIN `customers` AS `c` ON `i`.`customer_id` = `c`.`customer_id`
LEFT JOIN `warehouses` AS `w` ON `i`.`warehouse_id` = `w`.`warehouse_id`
WHERE NOT (`i`.`is_cancelled`)
ORDER BY `i`.`invoice_id` DESC

SELECT `i`.`invoice_id` AS `Id`, `i`.`so_id` AS `SoId`, `i`.`customer_id` AS `CustomerId`, `i`.`warehouse_id` AS `WarehouseId`, CASE
    WHEN `c`.`customer_id` IS NOT NULL THEN `c`.`name`
    ELSE 'No customer'
END AS `CustomerName`, `c`.`email` AS `CustomerEmail`, CASE
    WHEN `w`.`warehouse_id` IS NOT NULL THEN `w`.`Name`
    ELSE 'All Warehouses'
END AS `WarehouseName`, `i`.`invoice_number` AS `InvoiceNumber`, `i`.`invoice_date` AS `InvoiceDate`, `i`.`due_date` AS `DueDate`, `i`.`status` AS `Status`, `i`.`total_amount` AS `TotalAmount`, `i`.`paid_amount` AS `PaidAmount`, `i`.`balance_amount` AS `BalanceAmount`, COALESCE((
    SELECT `c0`.`payment_method`
    FROM `customer_payments` AS `c0`
    WHERE (`c0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND NOT (`c0`.`is_cancelled`)
    ORDER BY `c0`.`payment_id`
    LIMIT 1), 'N/A') AS `PaymentMethod`, COALESCE((
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
    FROM `sales_returns` AS `s`
    WHERE (`s`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) AS `ReturnedAmount`, CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s0`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
        FROM `sales_returns` AS `s0`
        WHERE (`s0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s0`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN NULL
    WHEN COALESCE((
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s1`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
        FROM `sales_returns` AS `s1`
        WHERE (`s1`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s1`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) >= `i`.`total_amount` THEN 'Fully Returned'
    ELSE 'Partially Returned'
END AS `ReturnStatus`, (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM `invoice_items` AS `i0`
    WHERE `i0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AS `ItemCount`
FROM `invoices` AS `i`
LEFT JOIN `customers` AS `c` ON `i`.`customer_id` = `c`.`customer_id`
LEFT JOIN `warehouses` AS `w` ON `i`.`warehouse_id` = `w`.`warehouse_id`
WHERE NOT (`i`.`is_cancelled`)
ORDER BY `i`.`invoice_id` DESC
LIMIT @__p_1 OFFSET @__p_0

    WHEN `c`.`customer_id` IS NOT NULL THEN `c`.`name`
    ELSE 'No customer'
END AS `CustomerName`, `c`.`email` AS `CustomerEmail`, CASE
    WHEN `w`.`warehouse_id` IS NOT NULL THEN `w`.`Name`
    ELSE 'All Warehouses'
END AS `WarehouseName`, `i`.`invoice_number` AS `InvoiceNumber`, `i`.`invoice_date` AS `InvoiceDate`, `i`.`due_date` AS `DueDate`, `i`.`status` AS `Status`, `i`.`total_amount` AS `TotalAmount`, `i`.`paid_amount` AS `PaidAmount`, `i`.`balance_amount` AS `BalanceAmount`, COALESCE((
    SELECT `c0`.`payment_method`
    FROM `customer_payments` AS `c0`
    WHERE (`c0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND NOT (`c0`.`is_cancelled`)
    ORDER BY `c0`.`payment_id`
    LIMIT 1), 'N/A') AS `PaymentMethod`, COALESCE((
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
    FROM `sales_returns` AS `s`
    WHERE (`s`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) AS `ReturnedAmount`, CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s0`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
        FROM `sales_returns` AS `s0`
        WHERE (`s0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s0`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN NULL
    WHEN COALESCE((
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s1`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
        FROM `sales_returns` AS `s1`
        WHERE (`s1`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s1`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) >= `i`.`total_amount` THEN 'Fully Returned'
    ELSE 'Partially Returned'
END AS `ReturnStatus`, (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM `invoice_items` AS `i0`
    WHERE `i0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AS `ItemCount`
FROM `invoices` AS `i`
LEFT JOIN `customers` AS `c` ON `i`.`customer_id` = `c`.`customer_id`
LEFT JOIN `warehouses` AS `w` ON `i`.`warehouse_id` = `w`.`warehouse_id`
WHERE NOT (`i`.`is_cancelled`)
ORDER BY `i`.`invoice_id` DESC

    WHEN `c`.`customer_id` IS NOT NULL THEN `c`.`name`
    ELSE 'No customer'
END AS `CustomerName`, `c`.`email` AS `CustomerEmail`, CASE
    WHEN `w`.`warehouse_id` IS NOT NULL THEN `w`.`Name`
    ELSE 'All Warehouses'
END AS `WarehouseName`, `i`.`invoice_number` AS `InvoiceNumber`, `i`.`invoice_date` AS `InvoiceDate`, `i`.`due_date` AS `DueDate`, `i`.`status` AS `Status`, `i`.`total_amount` AS `TotalAmount`, `i`.`paid_amount` AS `PaidAmount`, `i`.`balance_amount` AS `BalanceAmount`, COALESCE((
    SELECT `c0`.`payment_method`
    FROM `customer_payments` AS `c0`
    WHERE (`c0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND NOT (`c0`.`is_cancelled`)
    ORDER BY `c0`.`payment_id`
    LIMIT 1), 'N/A') AS `PaymentMethod`, COALESCE((
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
    FROM `sales_returns` AS `s`
    WHERE (`s`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) AS `ReturnedAmount`, CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s0`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
        FROM `sales_returns` AS `s0`
        WHERE (`s0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s0`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN NULL
    WHEN COALESCE((
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`s1`.`grand_total`), 0.0)
        FROM `sales_returns` AS `s1`
        WHERE (`s1`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AND `s1`.`status` IN ('Processed', 'Refunded')), 0.0) >= `i`.`total_amount` THEN 'Fully Returned'
    ELSE 'Partially Returned'
END AS `ReturnStatus`, (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM `invoice_items` AS `i0`
    WHERE `i0`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`) AS `ItemCount`
FROM `invoices` AS `i`
LEFT JOIN `customers` AS `c` ON `i`.`customer_id` = `c`.`customer_id`
LEFT JOIN `warehouses` AS `w` ON `i`.`warehouse_id` = `w`.`warehouse_id`
WHERE NOT (`i`.`is_cancelled`)
ORDER BY `i`.`invoice_id` DESC
